page.layout: One column of running text, with a printed page number and running head at the top. No marginal notes are printed on this page. Verse stanzas are set as indented lines within the column. Catchword and signature are at the foot on the right.

main_text.p: ficit. Dum uero Perusium anno Domini 1216. pro tollendis (sed ingentis lucri gratia) dissidijs inter Genuenses & Pisanos, profectus esset, uitam morte commutauit. Eius tempore Liuonia Papisticam suscepit religionem. Petrus quoq; Arragonū rex, Papistarum praestigijs excaecatus, feudatarium Papæ Romano suum regnum cum omnibus suis ditionibus fecit (Vincentio teste) ut animæ salutem meretur[?] & ita bestiam adorabat, Apoc. 13.

In Anglia nobilis quidam, audiens sacerdotum coniugia in Lateranensi synodo iterum damnari per istum Innocentium, hunc rhythmum sequente anno Domini, scilicet 1216. cecinit, ut Oxonij in uetustissimo quodam codice Ioannes Pullanus reperit, & ad me misit.

p.i: Prisciani regula penitus cassatur, Sacerdos per hic & hæc olim declinatur: Sed per hic solummodo nunc articulatur, Cum per nostrum præsulem hæc amoueatur:

main_text.p: Ita quidam presbyter cæpit allegare: Peccat criminaliter, qui uult separare, Quod Deus coniunxerat, fœminam amare. Tales dignum duximus, fures appellare.

p.i: O quàm dolor anxius, quàm tormentum grauè, Nobis est dimittere, quoniam suaue. O Romanæ pontifex, statuisti prauè,

page.notes: The first word "ficit." is a fragment carried over from the previous page. "S" at the foot left of "Ne" is read as a gathering signature, with "Ne" as the catchword; both are doubtful. The word "meretur" at the end of the Vincentius sentence is doubtful: the line break reads "me-" then "reretur", and the printed form may be "mereretur" or "meretur". The line-end breaks "morte", "Papæ" and "ditionibus" are restored without a printed hyphen, which is not clearly visible in the scan. The verse stanza breaks are reconstructed from indentation and italic type, and the boundaries between stanzas are approximate. The faint marks along the right edge are stains, not text.
